query:
SELECT j.status, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(ae.amount) as valor_total
FROM journals j 
LEFT JOIN accountingEntries ae ON ae.journalId = j.id
WHERE j.competenceMonth = '2026-01' 
GROUP BY j.status;
